objectives.label: Stand up when you're called
objectives.text: Braun is going round the room. When your name comes up, stand, and say who you are — your name, your age, man or woman, and the 'Who you are' paragraph on your You tab. Listen to the rest. Three people in this room are murderers.

objectives.label: You're up
objectives.text: You're up. Stand, and tell the room your name, your age, man or woman, and read 'Who you are' from your You tab. Stay in character.

objectives.label: Everyone to the study
objectives.text: Something has happened. Everyone make your way to the study — now. Stay together, and touch nothing.

objectives.label: Thirty minutes
objectives.text: Thirty minutes. Spread out through the house, find the nine cards and scan them — and scan the guests. Scanning somebody's code starts a conversation: three questions each, taking turns. Star what matters in your Interactions tab.

objectives.label: The Syndicate's hand
objectives.text: The three of you share one touch on the evidence tonight, and it's live now. Stand at any clue card, pick who your story points at, and Plant something of theirs or Scrub the card. The moment it fires, all three of your alibis change to put that person near the study — so decide together, and decide who.

objectives.label: Get your story straight
objectives.text: The three of you need one airtight story. Find your partners now, agree on where you each were at 9:40, and never be caught updating it. The first contradiction hangs all three of you.

objectives.label: Point it at yourself
objectives.text: The room is looking for a killer. Make sure what they find points at you. Stand at a clue card and Incriminate Yourself — Subtle or Blatant, twice tonight — and from then on your own answers start confessing. Be seen somewhere you shouldn't be.

objectives.label: The accusation round
objectives.text: Time's up. Everyone back to the main room. Five minutes: who seemed strange, who went quiet, whose answers didn't match somebody else's? Say it out loud. The first trial follows.

objectives.label: The first trial
objectives.text: The first trial is called. Vote for whoever you suspect. The four with the most votes take the stand, defend themselves, answer the jury — then everyone chooses. The top two go down.

objectives.label: Which card was touched?
objectives.text: Forensics is ready. Compare the clue cards you've each scanned, decide which one smells wrong, and spend it on that card. Find the tampered card and you find the Syndicate's fingerprints.

objectives.label: Find the killer
objectives.text: The Hard Question is ready. Confer with your fellow investigators, pick the one guest whose answer decides everything, and ask it. Then trust what it tells you — unless you have a reason not to.

objectives.label: Take the blame
objectives.text: Between the two of you, one may Take the Blame tonight. Do it and, if convicted, your card reads KILLER and the room counts you as one of the hands. Hold it for the final deliberation if you'd rather — it dies unspent at the last verdict.

objectives.label: Family secrets
objectives.text: Family Secrets is ready. Pick your target — your rival, or whoever the room might convict instead of you — and pull their motive into the light. The estate goes to the last claimant standing.

objectives.label: The second trial
objectives.text: The second trial is called. Who benefited from the first verdict? Who went quiet?

objectives.label: Last words
objectives.text: Ten minutes, and then the last trial. Everything anyone knows is already in the room — compare your starred answers, find the contradiction, and say the thing you've been sitting on.

objectives.label: Last chance
objectives.text: This is the Syndicate's last hour. If the blame is still unclaimed between you, it dies worthless after this trial — take it now or never.

objectives.label: The final trial
objectives.text: The final trial is called. Whatever is still hidden stays hidden after tonight — cast your vote, and live with it.

objectives.label: Question someone
objectives.text: Find {target}. Scan their code and ask them where they were when Braun was murdered — and don't accept the first answer. Check it against what somebody else told you.

objectives.label: Search a room
objectives.text: Nobody has looked properly in {zone}. Go now, find where a card might be hiding, and scan what you find. Come back with something or don't come back smug.

objectives.label: Compare notes
objectives.text: Find {target}. Put your phones side by side and compare your starred answers — between the two of you, one contradiction is sitting there waiting to be noticed.
